summary: Gone lookout on Maple Lake, Idaho County: two-story cupola cabin built 1925 (D-6 per Forest Lookouts); no removal date or staffing found.

facts.design: two-story cabin with cupola; the Forest Lookouts page calls it a D-6 cupola cabin
facts.status_note: Marked gone by Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com; no removal date or cause given.
facts.agency: Clearwater National Forest (Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com add Nez Perce)

events.note: Two-story cabin with cupola; firelookout.com says frame

evidence.supports: does not yet have a documented staffing history
evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: 1925 two-story frame cabin with cupola, marked gone
14 miles south of the Powell Ranger Station
Clearwater and Nez Perce National Forests

corrections.why: Idaho is the state; firelookout.com gives Idaho County, Idaho and the Forest Lookouts page lists IDAHO COUNTY

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts names only the Clearwater National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com name the Clearwater and Nez Perce forests together. The record keeps Clearwater and this file notes the second forest.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the build year, form and D-6 label agree across the three sources, but no source gives a removal date, cause, staffing or site description. Elevation 7,554 ft appears in two sources; the record has no elevation field filled. The photo credited to Idaho Fire Lookouts is already in the record, so no new photo is listed.
